meta._comment: Puzzle game metadata. Focus on mechanics and level design.
meta.title: My Puzzle Game
meta.description: Describe your puzzle game — the core mechanic, theme, difficulty curve, and what makes puzzles satisfying to solve.
meta._comment_art_style: minimalist, stylized, or pixel_art_2d work well for puzzle games.

mechanics._comment: Custom mechanics are the heart of puzzle games. Define your unique rules here.

custom_mechanics._comment: Define the core puzzle mechanic here. This is what makes your game unique.
custom_mechanics.name: Block Pushing
custom_mechanics.description: Push blocks onto target tiles to solve each level. Blocks can only be pushed, not pulled. Some blocks have special properties.
rules: Push blocks by walking into them.
Blocks slide until they hit a wall or another block.
Heavy blocks require two pushes in sequence.
Magnetic blocks attract or repel each other.
Ice blocks slide until hitting a wall.

custom_mechanics.name: Color Matching
custom_mechanics.description: Some blocks and tiles are colored. Matching colors creates interactions.
rules: Color changes propagate through connected blocks.
interactions: Red + Blue = Purple (activates both switch types).
Matching block to target tile completes the level.

world._comment: For puzzle games, environments are more like level themes/worlds.

environments.name: Tutorial Garden
environments.visual_description: A peaceful garden with simple grid floors and soft green colors. Flowers mark the goal areas. Clean, inviting, low-pressure environment.
environments.audio_mood: Gentle ambient music, soft wind chimes, birds chirping.

sub_areas.name: Basics
sub_areas.description: Learn to push blocks onto targets.

sub_areas.name: Sliding
sub_areas.description: Blocks that slide until hitting walls.

environments.name: Color Laboratory
environments.visual_description: A sterile lab environment with glowing neon panels. Each section has a dominant color. Grid floors with light-up tiles.
environments.audio_mood: Electronic ambient hum, soft beeps, synthesized tones.

sub_areas.name: Color Mixing
sub_areas.description: Combine colors to create new interactions.

environments.name: Frozen Vault
environments.visual_description: Ice-themed puzzles with slippery floors. Cool blue palette with crystal and frost visual effects.
environments.audio_mood: Crystalline echoes, gentle wind, deep reverb.

sub_areas.name: Ice Basics
sub_areas.description: Blocks slide on ice indefinitely until hitting walls.

sub_areas.name: Thaw Puzzles
sub_areas.description: Heat sources melt ice paths to create new routes.

entities._comment: Puzzle games may have minimal entities. The player is often simple.

player.visual_description: Simple geometric shape or small character. Clear and readable on the puzzle grid.

abilities.name: Push
abilities.description: Push adjacent blocks by moving into them.

abilities.name: Reset
abilities.description: Reset the current puzzle to its starting state.

logic._comment: For puzzle games, levels/quests define the puzzle progression.

steps.description: Push the block onto the target.
Push two blocks onto two targets.
Navigate around walls to reach the target.
Mix colors for the first time.
Complete the final color mixing puzzle.
